question: **Select the sentence with the appropriate use of preposition.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. 'Children are fond of sweets. .'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition **"of"** is the appropriate preposition to use after the verb **"fond"** to express a **liking or preference for something.**
 
• In this case, the phrase **"fond of"** in relation to **"sweets"** means having a liking or love for sweets.
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Many people are **fond of **French cheeses.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.​

 

Correct sentence:__ *Children are fond of sweets. *

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__***

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the prepositions given in the options: 

 
 
 

 Preposition
 Usage
 
 
 
 

 to
 used to indicate the direction and place; to indicate relationship; to indicate a limit; to refer a period of time. 
 
 

 off
 used to indicate away from someone or something; to denote moving away from a place, time or position. 
 
 

 with
 to say that people or things are in a place together; to denote an instrument. 
 
 

 of
 used to indicate relating to, belonging to; to indicate reference or preference; to specify the number or an amount.
